title: Form and injuries on the pick cards
items: Open ⓘ Matchup on any game to see each team's last 5 results (W/L) and key injuries (Out, Doubtful, Questionable), from ESPN.
Joined players can now get to the AAFL straight from the AASN bar at the top of every pool, and from the AASN home page.

title: Rules, What's New and email reminders
items: New Rules page: how picks, the weekly lock, the pick reveal, standings and joining work.
New What's New page (this one), with the latest updates on the AAFL home page.
Email reminders: one on Tuesday when picks open, and one on Thursday if you still have games to pick. Turn them off any time on the Picks page.

title: Real picks, invites and the pick reveal
items: The AAFL is invite only: open your invite link, sign in with the email it was sent to, and name your team.
Joining mid-season? You get the league average for every week you missed, and start with the next week that hasn't kicked off.
Your picks now save to your account. Change them as often as you like until the week locks at its first kickoff.
Picks stay private until the week locks. Then everyone's picks show on Standings → Weekly picks, marked right or wrong as games finish.
Human players are marked (h) in the standings.

title: Live league data
items: Every NFL game, score and line is saved for the AAFL and refreshed every 15 minutes.
Picks are graded automatically the moment each game goes final.
The 10 computer teams pick for each new week as soon as it opens.

title: Ticker look, logos and speed
items: The scores ticker now looks and scrolls exactly the same on the AAHL, AABL and AAFL.
Clearer team logos on dark backgrounds, and a losing team's logo no longer fades away.
The AAFL now has its own pill in the AASN bar at the top of every pool, and a card on the AASN home page.

title: Standings and the computer teams
items: 10 computer teams join the 2026 trial, each making random picks for every game since Week 1.
New Standings page: season table with 1st, 2nd and 3rd marked, % correct, weekly wins and movement since last week.
Tap any team for its season: best and worst week, and points for every week.
Weekly picks view: every team's pick for every game of a week.
The home page standings show the top 10, and scroll for the rest.

title: Picks page and Results
items: Picks page: tap a team to pick it, with each game's line, over/under and win chance from the betting odds.
ⓘ Matchup shows records, home and road form, the stadium, weather, TV channel and teams coming off a bye.
Quick buttons to pick every favourite or every home team.
New Results page: every game from Week 1 to Week 18, with scores, records, byes and a summary for each week.

title: The AAFL is here
items: The Angry Alpaca Football League home page: this week's games, the picks countdown, standings and the latest news.
Live scores ticker under the menu: every game of the week, with live scores and finals. The label turns red while games are on.

title: Kickoff
items: The Angry Alpaca Football League is announced: an NFL pick'em where you pick the winner of every game, every week.
2026 is a free trial season, with the new AAFL logo and Cowboys navy and silver look.
